notes.trinkets: Trinkets are a gear slot that can provide shifting value across different areas of content. They are also the easiest piece to alter how offensive or defensive-minded you wish to be. Because of this, you should keep many of the trinkets you obtain and be ready to swap them out when the situation calls for it. If you are only interested in the absolute best general choices, then look to collect the damage/hybrid and defensive choices below.
